To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The most influential factor in choosing to major in a particular business discipline is interest in the field; 2) Students who major in a business field other than MIS are more influenced by the workload of their major than students who major in MIS; and 3) The influence of family and friends is greater for students who major in a non-MIS field than it is for students who major MIS.

(1) the factors that influence the decision to major in MIS are not significantly different from those that influence the decision of students in other majors; (2) the factors that are significant for the decision to major are not the same for all students; and (3) the factors that have the most influence are those related to the students’ personal interests.
• The most important factor in choosing a major is the student’s interest in the field.
